caption: Bumper cars race under a metal ceiling grid, and their poles throw small sparks where they scrape along it.

sa.check: Bumper cars drive on a floor under a metal ceiling grid.
Poles rise from the cars to the grid.
Small sparks fly where the poles scrape along the grid.
More than one car is driving.
The sparks are at the top of the poles, at the grid.

pc.expect: Sparks appear only at the tips of poles that touch the grid and move with each car; each flash is brief and gone.
pc.fail: Sparks appear at a point on the grid with no pole beneath; or a flash stays lit at one spot after the car has moved on; or sparks come from the pole's middle or from the car body; or the whole grid glows.

pc.expect: Each car has one pole to the grid; sparks leave nothing behind on the grid.
pc.fail: Glowing dots stay on the grid after a car passes; or a car has two poles or none while sparking; or a car appears or vanishes; or a pole detaches and stays in the air.

pc.expect: Spark fragments fall from the grid toward the floor and go dark within a short distance.
pc.fail: Sparks rise above the grid and gather; or hang in the air; or lie glowing on the floor for the rest of the clip.

pc.expect: Each pole is a rigid rod from car to grid, bending only slightly; the grid stays a fixed flat ceiling.
pc.fail: A pole bends like rubber or curls; or the grid sags or ripples where a pole touches; or a pole stretches longer as the car moves.

pc.expect: The poles touch the underside of the grid; cars pass through neither each other nor the walls.
pc.fail: A pole passes up through the grid; or two cars merge as they bump; or a car passes through the barrier wall; or a car passes through another car.

pc.expect: The cars' colours and numbers, the floor and the grid stay the same.
pc.fail: A car changes colour or number; or the floor pattern changes; or the grid changes spacing.

note: The cars are driven vehicles; their steering, speed and bumps are not judged.
